page_title: BET 3-5 BAR | Betis v Barcelona 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+5' It looks like Valentin Gomez (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Francisco Maeso won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+3' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' 3 - 5 Goal! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Joan Garcia to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
90' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' The game is interrupted. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Betis.
89' Junior Firpo is being substituted because of an injury. Manuel Pellegrini sends Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) on the pitch.
88' Manuel Pellegrini (Betis) gets a yellow card, off the field.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentin Gomez (Betis) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
85' 2 - 5 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Diego Llorente (Betis) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Abde Ezzalzouli knock down. 2:5.
84' Pablo Fornals (Betis) steps up to send the ball in.
84' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) takes the corner with a short pass.
83' A pass by Aitor Ruibal (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
82' Pablo Garcia (Betis) is flagged for offside.
81' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Eric Garcia is replaced by Jofre Torrents (Barcelona).
79' A goal, which was scored by Pablo Garcia (Betis), was disallowed due to offside.
77' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Pablo Garcia (Betis) is replacing Antony.
75' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to find Ferran Torres, but he puts too much power on the pass.
74' The flag is raised and Pablo Fornals (Betis) is offside again, not for the first time today.
74' Fermín (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
73' Antony (Betis) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Joan Garcia with a brilliant diving save!
71' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

71' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Betis get a corner.
70' Fermín (Barcelona) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
69' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
68' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Fermín (Barcelona) replaces Roony Bardghji.
67' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
66' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) took the corner.
63' That's the end of the game for Pedri, who is replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
63' Today's match ends for Gerard Martin who will be replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
62' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' Here is a change. Natan is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Junior Firpo (Betis).
60' Substitution. Marc Bartra did his best and is replaced by Diego Llorente (Betis).
59' Nelson Deossa (Betis) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
59' 1 - 5 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alvaro Valles into the bottom left corner.
59' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' It’s a PENALTY to Barcelona after the VAR review!

56' Play continues despite the shouts by some Barcelona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Francisco Maeso interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

55' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Alvaro Valles anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
54' Surely that's handball by one of the Betis players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
54' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
53' Dangerous play by Pablo Fornals (Betis). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) is about to take a corner kick.
51' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

47' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Alvaro Valles, who pulls off a stunning save!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Sergi Altimira (Betis). He is replaced by Nelson Deossa.
46' Half-time substitution. Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) will not participate anymore and Andreas Christensen is coming on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
45+5' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+4' Looks like Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45+1' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Sergi Altimira (Betis) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
44' A pass from Valentin Gomez (Betis) is intercepted by Joan Garcia and the move breaks down.

42' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Alvaro Valles to get hold of the ball.
40' 1 - 4 Goal! Pedri passes the ball to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Alvaro Valles couldn't do anything about it. 1:4.
39' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
39' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
35' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
34' Sergi Altimira (Betis) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
33' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antony (Betis).
31' 1 - 3 Goal! Pedri displays great vision and sends a pass to Roony Bardghji (Barcelona), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 1:3.
30' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Alvaro Valles displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ferran Torres (Barcelona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
29' Pablo Fornals (Betis) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
28' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
26' The corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is intercepted by Alvaro Valles.
25' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
24' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
23' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
21' Sergi Altimira (Betis) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
20' Sergi Altimira (Betis) jumps into a tackle and Francisco Maeso signals a foul.
19' A pass into the penalty area from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is intercepted by the defence.
18' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
15' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
15' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' 1 - 2 What a goal! Roony Bardghji plays it to Ferran Torres (Barcelona), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alvaro Valles low into the middle of the net. 1:2.

11' 1 - 1 Goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Jules Kounde assisted in the goal. 1:1.
10' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.
9' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Antony (Betis) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
5' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
4' Antony (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
3' Pedri (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
1' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Francisco Maeso interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francisco Maeso.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
